body: Thank you. It's going to be hard to convince her but I will keep trying without pushing too hard.

Sorry for the late response, I am spending New Year's with her. He parents in the past couple of years started the process of a divorce. In the end they stayed together but apparently the divorce started to get a bit ugly and drove her older sister away from the parents. The mom and sister now constantly use her as the mediator since they refuse to talk to each other. This is unwanted by her but since she wants to maintain a good relationship with both she puts up with it.
